data.name: Rakul
data.gender_notes: Rakul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rakul means 'Fortune' or 'Wealth' in Sanskrit and Telugu. This name is derived from the root word 'Raksha' which means 'to protect'. The name is believed to bring good fortune and wealth to the bearer. The name Rakul carries the meaning “Fortune, Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu. Parents who choose Rakul usually hope their child will grow to embody fortune, wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rakul is a divine name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name Rakul invokes the blessings of the goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. This name is also associated with the element earth, which is symbolic of stability, grounding, and abundance.
data.etymology: Rakul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortune, Wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rakul total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
